{{Quote|Don't worry about me. Get rid of Lord Pompous here.|Kira Carsen, about Ferav|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
'''Ferav''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A servant of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], Ferav accompanied Angral to the [[Ord Mantell Orbital Station]] in [[3643 BBY]] to interrogate the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] as to the whereabouts of her [[Hero of Tython|master]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who [[Death/Legends|killed]] Angral's son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]. When Angral's other retainers departed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Ferav remained behind with Carsen as his captive while waiting for a shuttle to the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and the Inquisitor was surprised when the Knight arrived on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] not long afterwards. However, Ferav and his [[Imperial soldier]]s were unable to defeat the Knight in battle, and the Sith was cut down along with his men.

==Biography==
{{Quote|So your Master was here all along. Well-played, Padawan. Your lies convinced even Darth Angral.|Ferav, upon the Knight's arrival in the airlock|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Ferav was trained in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and became a [[Sith Inquisitor]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and he soon became a retainer of the more powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="New Intelligence" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Angral's son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]], and a furious Angral promptly [[Desolator crisis|declared war]] on the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in response. When [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] identified [[Kira Carsen]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight's]] apprentice, on the [[Ord Mantell Orbital Station]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], the Sith Lord and his retainers were over twenty [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] away. Despite this, Angral ordered her capture and immediately set off for the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] with Ferav,<ref name="New Intelligence" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hacklin]] of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]],<ref name="Defector">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Defector|Abandoned Mining Facility}}</ref> and several of Angral's other retainers in order to interrogate the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. However, Carsen resisted the interrogation and was able to convince Angral that her master was in fact on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], when the Knight was really down below on Ord Mantell with the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|raiding]] an [[Imperial Listening Post|Imperial listening post]] in order to learn Angral's plans.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

[[File:Ferav_and_Kira.png|thumb|right|250px|Ferav holds Carsen hostage.]]
Satisfied, Angral sent his forces to Corellia while he departed with Admiral Hacklin in order to oversee the installation of the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] on Angral's warship [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']]. The Sith Lord left Ferav behind with Carsen, two [[Imperial soldier]]s, and two [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] in the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] to the [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|Knight's ship]] so that Carsen could be picked up by a transfer [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that would take her to the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for further interrogation. Ferav was explicitly ordered not to kill Carsen, though that did not stop him from threatening the Padawan's life in order to force cooperation when the Knight and T7-O1, or Teeseven, arrived in the airlock. However, Carsen called his bluff, informing her master of Angral's orders to the contrary, and Ferav pushed the bound Padawan to the side before drawing his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and ordering his men to attack the Knight and Teeseven. Despite the Imperials' advantage of numbers, Ferav and his allies were unable to defeat the Jedi and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], and the Inquisitor was soon killed along with all four of his subordinates.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'll never understand what drives you Jedi to throw away your lives. You risk certain death to free this girl. Why? Some misguided sense of duty?|Ferav|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
Ferav had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin, though the right side of his face featured a number of scars across his cheek. He was also bald. The Inquisitor was arrogant and confident in the superiority of his abilities, and was willing to use deception in order to force a favorable outcome when presented with an opportunity to do so. Ferav was unable to understand why members of the Jedi Order were willing to give up their lives for others, and he saw their sense of duty to the greater [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] as misguided and futile.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|You do realize you're vastly outnumbered? Not to mention outmatched.|Ferav, on his combat abilities.|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
A Sith Inquisitor, Ferav carried a single red-bladed lightsaber in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], and he made use of storms of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] against his opponents in battle.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Equipment==
Ferav wore a set of hooded robes that were black and gray in color.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This isn't about duty. It's personal.''"<br />"''My, aren't ''you'' the interesting one. Pity you have to die.|Ferav takes interest in the male Jedi Knight's romance with Kira Carsen|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
[[File:The_Old_Republic_cover.png|thumb|right|180x|Ferav appeared in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''.]]
Ferav appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. Players of the Jedi Knight class encounter him in the last stages of the mission "New Intelligence," where he and his men block the path back to the player's ship aboard the Ord Mantell Orbital Station after the Knight returns from the mission to Ord Mantell's surface. Regardless of dialogue choices, Ferav will attack the player and be killed in the resulting fight.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

If the Jedi Knight is male, when asked by Ferav why he would risk his life for Kira Carsen, he has the option to hint to Ferav that he is in love with the girl. Ferav is intrigued by the Knight's infatuation with Kira and expresses regret on having to kill him.<ref name="New Intelligence" />
